source: Team discussion draft for Tables 8.3/8.4 and Section 8 extraction guide; extended with categories observed in K143272. Use a listed category when it fits; otherwise propose 'NEW: <label>' and explain in note.
raw_acquired_signal_rule: Name the physical signal as the document describes it. Add '(waveform not specified)' unless the document calls it a waveform or continuous signal. Use 'Not specified' only as the category of a Not stated claim.

relations.component_of: a patient-interface/module claim is part of a sensing system (e.g. cannula → pressure sensor)
relations.measures: sensor → physiological parameter, used when the document links them directly without describing a raw signal
relations.reported_as: diagnostic output → physiological parameter it is computed from
relations.generated_by: output/feature → the report or software claim that produces it

bases.same-cell: both ends are stated together in one subject-column cell
bases.output-name: the output's own label names the parameter (e.g. 'Average SpO2')
bases.not-stated: the link is not stated; record the gap (policy A: outputs such as AHI/REI/ODI are NOT linked to a signal unless the document says which signals they use)
